title: Trie: Prefix Check
statement:
Build a Trie from a set of words, then answer Q prefix queries.

For each query prefix P, print "Yes" if any word in the Trie starts with P, otherwise print "No".
constraints:
1 <= W <= 1000
1 <= Q <= 1000
1 <= |word|, |prefix| <= 20
All words/prefixes are lowercase letters.
inputFormat:
The first line contains W.
The next W lines each contain a word.
The next line contains Q.
The next Q lines each contain a prefix.
outputFormat: Q lines: "Yes" or "No" for each query.

examples.input:
3
apple
app
bat
3
ap
bat
ba
examples.explanation: 'ap' is a prefix of 'apple'/'app'; 'bat' and 'ba' match.
